meta.name: reshelve-returns
meta.comment: Puts every returned copy back on its shelf.

meta.name: circulation-checkout
meta.comment: Checks a title out to a borrower: asks the members service about the borrower, the catalogue for a copy, writes the loan, tells the catalogue and the members service about it, and starts the members service's notices.

meta.name: members-borrower-notices
meta.comment: Sends a borrower a notice, and tries once more an hour later if the mail service refuses it.
